تلاصقت (form VI)
# تَلَاصَقْتُ (talāṣaqtu) /ta.laː.sˤaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَاصَقَ (talāṣaqa)
# تَلَاصَقْتَ (talāṣaqta) /ta.laː.sˤaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَاصَقَ (talāṣaqa)
# تَلَاصَقْتِ (talāṣaqti) /ta.laː.sˤaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَاصَقَ (talāṣaqa)
# تَلَاصَقَتْ (talāṣaqat) /ta.laː.sˤa.qat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
